newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Police seize immigrant-trafficker to Czech republic.
newsitem.headline: Police seize immigrant-trafficker to Czech republic.

text.p: Moroccan police have arrested a specialist forger running an illegal immigration network towards Italy and Germany through the Czech republic, the official Moroccan news agency MAP said on Wednesday.
Mohamed el Youssoufi was seized as he approached a Casablanca railway station, with seven Moroccan passports in his possession.

MAP said he had confessed to setting up an import/export firm in 1994 to hide his activities and that with the help of a Moroccan accomplice in the Czech republic provided documents for immigrants to go there for between 20,000 and 30,000 dirhams ($2,100 and $3,200).
It added that he had also sent 12 people to Hungary with the help of his accomplice.
